page.notes: The first word of the page is a fragment ("gumentum") continuing from the previous page. The initial of "Quod" at the start of the chapter paragraph is a decorative woodcut ornament; the letter beneath it is read as Q with [?]. "v o D" in the scan is spaced capitals inside the ornament. Printed "Sinon" and "funt.omnis" lack spaces and are kept as printed. "eft" is transcribed as est, "effe" as esse, long s as plain s, per the rules. A small mark at the far left edge is a rule or edge, not text.
